_doc: Chân Kim Các's Effect engine records (world-depth Stage 6; ADR-0009). Merged into assets/data/combat_effects.json under source world-depth:chan_kim by the serial step. Unpriced. Declares every counter it reads or writes in its own counters array for standalone GDScript compilation.

True Gold Does Not Fear the Furnace.rule: True Gold Does Not Fear the Furnace (Chân Kim Bất Phạ Hỏa, true-gold-canon L4 passive art, d31): each buff stack you strip from the foe, and each ward share your Assay strips, restores 1.5 % of your maximum linh lực and adds one Part the Dross stack (4 s).
True Gold Does Not Fear the Furnace.approx: the engine's strip action does not report exact stack count removed, so multi-stack strips (The Furnace Shows, Tried and Stamped) count 1 trigger per strip event rather than 1 per stack

Nothing False Survives.rule: Hundred-Fold Crucible (ck-hundred-fold-crucible): every buff, ward or borrowed stat a foe gains while near you burns off twice as fast. You can tell whether any item you are shown is what its owner says it is.
Nothing False Survives.approx: "burns off twice as fast" is modelled as ward_bill +100 (foe drain ward burns linh lực 2x as fast) and stripping 1 buff stack every 2 s; out-of-fight item appraisal sentence is lore

A Hair Light.rule: The House Weight (ck-house-weight): once a fight, you may make one roll that weighs against you come out slightly in your favour (a dodge, a resist or a crit).
A Hair Light.approx: when struck (a defensive roll went against you) while a charge holds, spends 1 charge to tip the next exchange in your favour (+25 evade and +25 status_resist for 3 s, and your next direct hit is a guaranteed crit)

Touchstone.rule: Hallmark Seal (ck-hallmark-seal, d38): once per art firing, your first hit on a foe that holds buff stacks strips one of them (its largest pile, oldest batch first).

Tried and Stamped.rule: Assayer's Tools, full set (3 pieces: ck-hundred-fold-crucible, ck-hallmark-seal, ck-refiner-robe): a foe your art hits while it carries a buff is stamped for 6 s; the next buff it gains burns off at once, and you gain a ward worth 5 % of your health.
Tried and Stamped.approx: the engine has no foe buff_gained event, so the 6 s stamp checks foe.buff_elements >= 1 on each pulse and consumes the stamp on burn; strip does not report exact stack count, so touchstone_stripped counts 1 per burn

A Second Lean.rule: Thumb on the Scale, full set (2 pieces: ck-house-weight, ck-counterweight-coin): the House Weight's tipped roll comes twice a fight; after each tipped roll you see the next art that foe will use.
A Second Lean.approx: grants +1 House Weight charge at fight_start; after each tipped roll, seeing the foe's next art grants +15 evade and +20 accuracy for 3 s
